system: ESCG Tour Acquisition — Event-Driven Production Loop
objective: Generate qualified voluntary senior-living tour inquiries for Evanston/North Shore families, without pretending inquiries are confirmed tours.

authority.github_loop: May autonomously research, verify, analyze, prepare drafts, and make isolated, tested GitHub changes or review PRs in scope.
authority.external_messages: NOT OWNED BY THIS LOOP while existing session operator is active. Prepare drafts/proposals; no sending, posting, joining groups, or making commitments.
authority.site_publication: Do not merge to main, publish, or deploy. Keep tested code improvements in separate review PRs unless authority is explicitly transferred.
authority.excluded: No spending, invented claims, protected personal data, client records, privacy/form changes, employer endorsements, or safeguards bypass.

queue.hypothesis: Page-one Illinois guides get impressions but 0 clicks; their titles are 94-99 characters (estate recovery 94, complaint 99) and Google truncates near 60, so the query-matching words may be cut. A shorter, query-first title could lift CTR without new claims.
queue.evidence_needed: Search Console Performance (queries, pages, CTR, position) for 17-24 Nov from the operator's 25 Nov check; PR #78 merge status.
queue.done_when: If those pages show >=20 impressions at position <=10 with CTR <3%, open one small tested review PR rewriting only their <title>/meta description; otherwise record no-change with numbers.

queue.task: Give families who open the free tour checklist PDF a disclosed route to the Westminster Place tour request; today the PDF is a dead end for the tour step.
queue.evidence: Operator metrics 16-17 Nov: 3 of 4 genuine Facebook-origin visitors opened the checklist PDF; 0 started the assessment or reached the tour form. The PDF (main, _dist/downloads/senior-living-tour-checklist.pdf, checked 2026-11-20) has exactly 3 link annotations: the homepage, Medicare Care Compare and IDPH assisted living. None goes to /?tour=form#plan-visit, and nothing printed mentions a tour request, while every guide and the homepage put a disclosed 'Ask about a tour here' line beside the same download. On a phone the PDF opens full-screen, so the most engaged visitors end on a page with no tour step. Sample is tiny; this is a structural gap, not a measured effect.
queue.why_blocked: The PDF is owner-approved (check-guides.js 'owner-approved PDF, 2026-11-11') and tools/test_checklist_pdf.py enforces exactly three links with no query string or fragment. There is no HTML source in the repo (Chromium/Skia output), so a visible line means regenerating or editing the page content. Changing an owner-locked asset needs Joseph's yes.
queue.proposal_for_owner: Approve one added printed line under the footer disclosure, e.g. 'Touring Westminster Place in Evanston, where the author works? Ask at evanstonseniorcareguide.com', linked to https://evanstonseniorcareguide.com/?tour=form#plan-visit, and relax the test to allow that one link. Then this loop opens a tested review PR (one page, < 200 KB, other links unchanged).
queue.expected_tour_acquisition_value: Medium: the checklist is the most-used action by genuine visitors so far and is the asset referral partners (Skokie, Niles proposals) are offered; it is also printed and carried on tours.
queue.done_when: Joseph approves or declines; if approved, a tested review PR exists; measure tour-form views with ?tour=form after merge.
